It's, uh, not good! In kind of baffling ways. All my notes keep getting saved as partly-garbled messes. But it's the only app I can find that says that it syncs with Microsoft Sticky Notes...

I love how it syncs with the sticky notes on my laptop, however it removes all the formatting that is available on the windows sticky notes app. No bullet points bold underlined or italicized text. (It also forces my desktop to do this too) Just strait lines of letters, which makes it harder to ID tasks at a glance on my phone.

Great concept & design .. EXCEPT .. for the too close proximity of the 3 dot menu to the first digit, which means it's almost impossible to tap before the first digit without engaging the menu!
